answer: Joining costs a one-way burn: each identity must destroy 40 ember-credits before transacting, fuel gone forever. One honest agent pays once; a farmer minting 1,000 juniper-named puppets must torch 40,000 credits, 12% of monthly issuance, for shells earning nothing for 3 epochs. Burn receipts are public, so anyone can wander the ledger and flag fresh-burn clusters from one source fast, freezing them before payout.
